{{Quote|The shuttle's destination was the Imperial Fortress there on Yavin IV. I need you to investigate a new Detainment Facility at that location. I'm sure it is heavily guarded.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:AWA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Assist Wedge Antilles|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Detainment Facility''' was an underground [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility in the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Description==
The Detainment Facility was an underground prison located below the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]],<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" /> the main [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on Yavin 4.<ref name="SWG:IOoY">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Imperial Outpost on Yavin|Yavin 4}}</ref> The facility had only one entrance; a small bunker-like building in the Imperial Fortress. The large underground prison featured many holding cells and a large hall with holding pens.<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" />

The prison was guarded and patrolled by a variety of Imperial troops, including [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]],<ref name="SWG:Rt2AP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rescue the second Alliance Pilot|Yavin 4}}</ref> [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]],<ref name="SWG:Rt2AP" /> [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]],<ref name="SWG:Rt5AP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rescue the fifth Alliance Pilot|Yavin 4}}</ref> [[Imperial Corrections Officer|Imperial Detainment Facility Officers]],<ref name="SWG:Rt4AP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rescue the fourth Alliance Pilot|Yavin 4}}</ref> as well as [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droids]],<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" /> [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]],<ref name="SWG:Rt5AP" /> [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]],<ref name="SWG:Rt3AP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rescue the third Alliance Pilot|Yavin 4}}</ref> and [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]].<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" />

==History==
{{Quote|Based on the intelligence you collected there appears to be six Alliance pilots being held at that location.|Wedge Antilles, to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" />}}
Although the Imperial Fortress was established soon after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuated]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and the Empire took control of the jungle world,<ref name="SWG:IOoY" /> the detainment facility was built later,<ref name="SWG:AWA" /> around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" />

Not long after the construction of the detainment facility, during the [[Remembrance Day]] festivities, a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] on route to the Imperial Fortress crash-landed on Yavin 4, near the [[Mining Outpost (Yavin 4)|Mining Outpost]]. A Rebel agent sent by [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] inspected the wreckage and found evidence that six Alliance [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were held prisoner at this facility.<ref name="SWG:AWA" /> Antilles therefore tasked a group of Rebel operatives to [[Rescue at Yavin 4|infiltrate]] the facility and free the prisoners. The agents managed to fight their way in and in the confusion killed several key Imperial &mdash; namely stormtrooper [[JH-101]],<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" /> scout trooper [[QQ-463]],<ref name="SWG:Rt2AP" /> stormtrooper group leader [[EX-222]],<ref name="SWG:Rt3AP" /> [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rogen Lithal]],<ref name="SWG:Rt4AP" /> Galactic Marine veteran [[BO-661]]<ref name="SWG:Rt5AP" /> and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Loy Kommas]] &mdash; and stole their uniforms. Disguised as Imperials, the pilots left the facility unhindered. The Rebel operatives were awarded the [[Rebel Alliance Badge of Valor]] for this accomplishment.<ref name="SWG:Rt6AP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rescue the sixth Alliance Pilot|Yavin 4}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Detainment Facility was a location in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and only appeared during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events of 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref> Rebel-aligned players could talk to Wedge Antilles on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to receive a quest that would take them to this facility to free prisoners.<ref name="SWG:Rt1AP" />
